edit.subject: The Mersenne prime 2^136279841 − 1

notes: Real: GIMPS announced on 21 October 2024 that Luke Durant found M136279841, then the largest known prime, using cloud GPUs (mersenne.org press release). It postdates most open models' training data, which name 2^82589933 − 1 as the record.
